change: Incremental coloring repairs small lists in one workgroup. color_bodies_local (256 threads) loops Jones-Plassmann rounds over the compact repair list behind storage barriers when it holds <= 4096 bodies (HOST_S(27) opt-in); write_work_args then writes slot 69 = 0 so the 32 global color_bodies rounds launch nothing. Larger lists (first step, mass wakes) keep the global rounds. Each JP attempt is shared as jpTryColor. The highest-priority uncolored body always colors and every uncolored neighbour is on the list, so each round progresses. Browser default repair=local under incremental coloring; native ENGINE_REPAIR=local.
postPassFix: uniformize_workgroup_lanes rewrote reads of gsUniformLanes to workgroupUniformLoad but its store fix-up pattern ') =' also matched ') ==', silently reverting uniform comparisons. The pattern now requires ') = '. No existing kernel compared the flag, so their WGSL is unchanged; color_bodies_local also joins the texture-barrier lowering fix.
